title: QuartzLine: A working PDF viewer with a backdoor inside
content: QuartzLine, also tracked as CLOUDHAZE by Mandiant, is malicious software disguised as a functional Windows PDF viewer that conceals a backdoor enabling attackers to execute commands and deploy additional malware. The malware has appeared as paperline.exe and fielddesk.exe, signed with a legitimate but now-revoked EV code-signing certificate. Distribution occurs through malicious advertising,... This pulse includes 18 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: QuartzLine, CLOUDHAZE, Caira.

title: ConnectWise (SkyKick) Vendor Credentials Abused in M365 Attacks
content: A Microsoft 365 API credential belonging to ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) was compromised and used to gain unauthorized access to customer M365 environments. The threat actor authenticated from IP address 144.172.64.128 on October 15, obtaining Microsoft Graph access tokens across hundreds of tenants. title: CVE-2026-88771: Inside the Exploitation of a Critical NetScaler RCE Vulnerability
content: On September 27, 2026, Citrix disclosed CVE-2026-88771, a critical remote code execution vulnerability affecting NetScaler Application Delivery Controller and NetScaler Gateway with a CVSS score of 9.8. The vulnerability enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands without requiring optional features. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following... title: YuanKong RAT: the Android remote-control service that stamps its operators' names into every build
content: YuanKong is a multi-tenant Android remote access trojan whose dropper stores decryption keys in cleartext configuration files. The malware uses a two-key XOR scheme to unpack payloads signed with a shared certificate across all operator builds. Each build embeds operator account identifiers as hardcoded string constants, including account IDs, operator handles, and enrollment codes that are... This pulse includes 15 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: YuanKong.
